svg.title: Exact starts, imperfect finishes
svg.desc: Eight panels trace strict, isolated, and core pass rates by checkpoint. Four opening checkpoints passed strictly; no final checkpoint did.

text.font-family: Geist, Avenir Next, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
Geist, Avenir Next, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Pass rate at every checkpoint; larger dots mark an exact 100% solve.
